# google_apigee_keystores_aliases_self_signed_cert (list)

Lists [`google_apigee_keystores_aliases_self_signed_cert`](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/google/latest/docs/resources/google_apigee_keystores_aliases_self_signed_cert) resources for use with [`terraform query`](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/query) and **`.tfquery.hcl`** files.

For how list resources work in this provider, file layout, Terraform version requirements, and shared `list` block arguments, refer to the guide [Use list resources with terraform query (Google Cloud provider)](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/google/latest/docs/guides/using_list_resources_with_terraform_query).

## Example

```hcl
list "google_apigee_keystores_aliases_self_signed_cert" "all" {
  provider = google

  config {
    org_id = "..."
    environment = "..."
    keystore = "..."
    alias = "..."
  }
}
```

Run `terraform query` from the directory that contains the `.tfquery.hcl` file.

## Configuration (`config` block)
* `org_id` - (Required) The Apigee Organization name associated with the Apigee environment

* `environment` - (Required) The Apigee environment name

* `keystore` - (Required) The Apigee keystore name associated in an Apigee environment

* `alias` - (Required) Alias for the key/certificate pair. Values must match the regular expression [\w\s-.]{1,255}.
This must be provided for all formats except selfsignedcert; self-signed certs may specify the alias in either
this parameter or the JSON body.
